_about: Input fixture for case 025-attestation-android-keystore — the §10.35 attestation envelope byte-form pin for the Android Keystore platform. The attestation document body is a synthetic placeholder; case 025 exercises the envelope byte form, not Android Keystore CBOR/X.509 parsing (that's the platform validator's job).
